  - name: Participants In FAS
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y')

      - fas count
      - analysis population count
      - population size

  - name: Participants With Valid Baseline
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'

    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND followup_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END

      - week 24 observation
      - in window
      - evaluable week 24

    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'

    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN 1 - COUNT_IF(FASFL\

    synonyms:

      - missing rate
      - missing data rate

    synonyms:

      - mean weight change
      - mean pchg

    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE\
      \ WHEN FASFL = 'Y' THEN PCHG END, 0.5) END"
    comment: Median percent change among FAS

  WHERE class_id = 'WRC-V1' AND kind = 'root'

  SELECT concept_id

),

  SELECT DISTINCT mh.USUBJID
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_mh mh
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc

    JOIN excludes e ON mc2.ancestor_code = e.concept_id

)

JOIN mh_match m

## 3,123 Randomized CSL-A Participants Have ≥ 1 Weight-Related Comorbidity (WRC-V1)

Of the **4,055** randomized CSL-A participants through 2026-10-31, **3,123 (77.0%)** have at least one weight-related comorbidity in their medical history, as defined by the protocol 1.0 / section 5.1 comorbidity class **WRC-V1**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e10d8af4ea0642f0a615a5eb9839644f?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_db4d89) [Weight-related comorbidity class (WRC-V1 / WRC-V2)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/ef6ec006-308e-475e-8bb5-ba22778d76cd?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### WRC-V1 Definition (Protocol 1.0)

WRC-V1 membership is determined by MONDO ontology subsumption — a condition qualifies if it is a descendant of any WRC-V1 root and **not** a descendant of any carve-out (exclusion wins). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-89a7dc7e-06b2-4ee4-b025-62f6045be5e0)

The 10 root conditions and three carve-outs (pulmonary hypertension, pregnancy-induced hypertension, congenital coronary artery malformation) are the original protocol 1.0 set — **before** Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0) added obstructive sleep apnea as WRC-V2. [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### Breakdown by Comorbidity Root

<!-- begin-embedded:query_aac568 -->
| comorbidity_root | participants |
| --- | --- |
| hypertensive disorder | 1352 |
| hyperlipidemia | 927 |
| type 2 diabetes mellitus | 504 |
| prediabetes syndrome | 502 |
| metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease | 254 |
| hypertriglyceridemia | 227 |
| coronary artery disorder | 173 |
| heart failure | 85 |
| stroke disorder | 41 |
| peripheral arterial disease | 37 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_aac568 -->

**Hypertensive disorder** is the most prevalent root, present in 1,352 participants, followed by **hyperlipidemia** (927) and **type 2 diabetes / prediabetes** (\~500 each). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e10d8af4ea0642f0a615a5eb9839644f?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_aac568) Note that participants can map to multiple roots, so the root-level counts sum to more than 3,123.

SQL Genie One ran:

WITH wrc_v1_members AS (
  -- All MONDO codes that are members of WRC-V1 (descendants of roots, minus descendants of exclude_roots)
  SELECT DISTINCT mc.descendant_code
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root r
    ON mc.ancestor_code = r.concept_id
   AND r.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND r.kind = 'root'
  WHERE mc.descendant_code NOT IN (
    SELECT x.descendant_code
    FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure x
    JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root e
      ON x.ancestor_code = e.concept_id
     AND e.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
     AND e.kind = 'exclude_root'
  )
),
randomized_csla AS (
  -- Randomized CSL-A participants through 2026-10-31
  SELECT p.USUBJID
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
    ON p.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID AND p.STUDYID = dm.STUDYID
  WHERE p.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
    AND p.randomized = true
    AND dm.CPL_RANDDT <= '2026-10-31'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.USUBJID) AS participants_with_wrc_v1_comorbidity,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM randomized_csla) AS total_randomized_csla
FROM randomized_csla r
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_mh mh
  ON r.USUBJID = mh.USUBJID
JOIN wrc_v1_members w
  ON mh.CPL_MONDO_ID = w.descendant_code



WITH randomized_csla AS (
  SELECT p.USUBJID
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
    ON p.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID AND p.STUDYID = dm.STUDYID
  WHERE p.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
    AND p.randomized = true
    AND dm.CPL_RANDDT <= '2026-10-31'
),
wrc_v1_excluded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.descendant_code
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure x
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root e
    ON x.ancestor_code = e.concept_id
   AND e.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND e.kind = 'exclude_root'
),
mh_with_root AS (
  -- For each MH record of a randomized CSL-A participant, find which WRC-V1 root(s) it maps to
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.USUBJID,
    cr.concept_id AS root_concept_id,
    mc_root.ancestor_name AS comorbidity_root
  FROM randomized_csla r
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_mh mh
    ON r.USUBJID = mh.USUBJID
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc
    ON mh.CPL_MONDO_ID = mc.descendant_code
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root cr
    ON mc.ancestor_code = cr.concept_id
   AND cr.class_id = 'WRC-V1'
   AND cr.kind = 'root'
  -- Get the root's own name from mondo_closure at depth 0
  JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure mc_root
    ON mc_root.descendant_code = cr.concept_id
   AND mc_root.ancestor_code = cr.concept_id
   AND mc_root.depth = 0
  WHERE mh.CPL_MONDO_ID NOT IN (SELECT descendant_code FROM wrc_v1_excluded)
)
SELECT
  comorbidity_root,
  COUNT(DISTINCT USUBJID) AS participants
FROM mh_with_root
GROUP BY comorbidity_root
ORDER BY participants DESC

version: 1.1

source: "SELECT r.*, p.ARMCD, p.SITEID, p.COUNTRY, p.FASFL, p.PPSFL FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result\
  \ r JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p USING\

comment: "Week 24 percent change in body weight from baseline, one row per randomized\
  \ participant x endpoint rule version (SYNTHETIC; ADaM-shaped, not submission-ready).\
  \ Every measure is NULL unless exactly one rule version is in scope: always filter\
  \ or group by `Rule Version`. Descriptive only; not evidence of efficacy."

dimensions:
  - name: Study
    expr: STUDYID

      - study
      - study id
      - trial
      - protocol

  - name: Rule Version
    expr: endpoint_version
    comment: "Executable endpoint rule version: EP-A-WT24.R1 (±7 days), EP-A-WT24.R2\
      \ (±14 days, Amendment 1), EP-B-WT24.R1 (mean baseline, ±10 days). Required\
      \ for every measure."
    synonyms:
      - rule version
      - endpoint version
      - definition version
      - R1
      - R2
      - analysis window version

  - name: Protocol Version
    expr: protocol_version
    comment: "Protocol version the rule version implements (1.0, 2.0)."
    synonyms:
      - protocol version
      - amendment

  - name: SAP Version
    expr: sap_version
    comment: Statistical analysis plan version the rule version implements.
    synonyms:
      - sap version
      - analysis plan version

  - name: Arm
    expr: ARMCD
    comment: "Randomized arm: CSL101 (CSL-101 10 mg once weekly) or PBO (placebo)."
    synonyms:
      - arm
      - treatment arm
      - treatment group
      - randomized arm

  - name: Site
    expr: SITEID
    comment: Investigational site.
    synonyms:
      - site
      - center
      - investigator site

  - name: Country
    expr: COUNTRY
    comment: Site country (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
    synonyms:
      - country
      - region

  - name: Result Status
    expr: result_status
    comment: "DERIVED, NO_VALID_BASELINE, NO_QUALIFYING_FOLLOWUP, NO_REFERENCE_DATE\
      \ or NOT_IN_POPULATION."
    synonyms:
      - status
      - result status
      - derivation status
      - evaluable

  - name: Exclusion Reason
    expr: exclusion_reason
    comment: "Why no endpoint was derived, e.g. NO_OBSERVATION_IN_WINDOW:closest_+10d\
      \ (the closest follow-up was 10 days after the target)."
    synonyms:
      - reason
      - exclusion reason
      - missing reason
      - why not derived

  - name: In FAS
    expr: FASFL
    comment: Y if the participant is in the full analysis set (randomized and dosed).
    synonyms:
      - fas
      - full analysis set

  - name: In PPS

    comment: Y if the participant is in the per-protocol set (FAS without a major
      protocol deviation).
    synonyms:

      - per-protocol set

measures:

      - "n"

  - name: Participants In FAS
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y')
      END

For CSL-A, protocol 3.0 is Amendment 2 and became effective on `2025-11-01`. It added obstructive sleep apnea to the weight-related comorbidity class used for screening on or after that date. The version change can be examined in `eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.study_version`.

Inferred snippet (business_logic) from Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect): CSL-A has two approved Week 24 windows, while CSL-B uses its own ten-day window and mean baseline.
In eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R1' for CSL-A R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, and the ±7 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R2' for CSL-A R2, protocol 2.0/SAP 2.0, Amendment 1, and the ±14 day window. INCLUDE endpoint_version = 'EP-B-WT24.R1' for CSL-B R1, protocol 1.0/SAP 1.0, mean baseline, and the ±10 day window. The synonym 'protocol 1.0' occurs for both studies and does not alone identify the endpoint version.

Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect) covers approved Week 24 endpoints, populations, missingness, and Amendment 1 impact for synthetic CSL-A and CSL-B. CSL-101 is a fictional GLP-1 receptor agonist, and the SDTM-/ADaM-shaped data are not submission-ready. Results are descriptive, with no efficacy, superiority, or causal interpretation. The endpoint source is eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result, rather than recalculated silver data; metric views provide the reporting measures. Reporting scope is per study and endpoint rule version, never pooled across studies or versions.

`eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.amendment_impact_metrics` is a Unity Catalog metrics view for the synthetic CSL-A Amendment 1 impact analysis. Each underlying comparison row represents one randomized CSL-A participant evaluated under endpoint rule versions R1 and R2; the only rule change is the Week 24 follow-up window, from ±7 days to ±14 days. Use the exposed dimensions and named measures for aggregated analysis rather than treating the metrics view as a raw participant table. ## CSL-A Amendment 1: Two Changes, Effective 2025-10-27

**Amendment 1** (protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0) took effect on **2025-10-27** and introduced two changes: [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

1. **Week 24 analysis window widened** — from **±7 days** to **±14 days** around the target date (study day 169). This applies to every CSL-A participant's endpoint; both the original rule (EP-A-WT24.R1) and the amended rule (EP-A-WT24.R2) are derived for all participants so the two can be compared. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-8cf7d79a-9162-4dd7-95b2-1cd395a59ccf)

2. **Obstructive sleep apnea added** to the weight-related comorbidity class used for eligibility screening. This change applies only to participants screened **on or after** 2025-10-27 (central sleep apnea was not added). [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

version: 1.1

source: "SELECT r.*, p.ARMCD, p.SITEID, p.COUNTRY, p.FASFL, p.PPSFL FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result\
  \ r JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p USING\

comment: "Week 24 percent change in body weight from baseline, one row per randomized\
  \ participant x endpoint rule version (SYNTHETIC; ADaM-shaped, not submission-ready).\
  \ Every measure is NULL unless exactly one rule version is in scope: always filter\
  \ or group by `Rule Version`. Descriptive only; not evidence of efficacy."

dimensions:
  - name: Study
    expr: STUDYID
    comment: "Study identifier: CSL-A (72-week obesity study) or CSL-B (52-week type\
      \ 2 diabetes study)."
    synonyms:
      - study
      - study id
      - trial
      - protocol

  - name: Rule Version
    expr: endpoint_version
    comment: "Executable endpoint rule version: EP-A-WT24.R1 (±7 days), EP-A-WT24.R2\
      \ (±14 days, Amendment 1), EP-B-WT24.R1 (mean baseline, ±10 days). Required\
      \ for every measure."
    synonyms:
      - rule version
      - endpoint version
      - definition version
      - R1
      - R2
      - analysis window version

  - name: Protocol Version
    expr: protocol_version
    comment: "Protocol version the rule version implements (1.0, 2.0)."
    synonyms:
      - protocol version
      - amendment

  - name: SAP Version
    expr: sap_version
    comment: Statistical analysis plan version the rule version implements.
    synonyms:
      - sap version
      - analysis plan version

  - name: Arm
    expr: ARMCD
    comment: "Randomized arm: CSL101 (CSL-101 10 mg once weekly) or PBO (placebo)."
    synonyms:
      - arm
      - treatment arm
      - treatment group
      - randomized arm

  - name: Site
    expr: SITEID
    comment: Investigational site.
    synonyms:
      - site
      - center
      - investigator site

  - name: Country
    expr: COUNTRY
    comment: Site country (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
    synonyms:
      - country
      - region

  - name: Result Status
    expr: result_status
    comment: "DERIVED, NO_VALID_BASELINE, NO_QUALIFYING_FOLLOWUP, NO_REFERENCE_DATE\
      \ or NOT_IN_POPULATION."
    synonyms:
      - status
      - result status
      - derivation status
      - evaluable

  - name: Exclusion Reason
    expr: exclusion_reason
    comment: "Why no endpoint was derived, e.g. NO_OBSERVATION_IN_WINDOW:closest_+10d\
      \ (the closest follow-up was 10 days after the target)."
    synonyms:
      - reason
      - exclusion reason
      - missing reason
      - why not derived

  - name: In FAS
    expr: FASFL
    comment: Y if the participant is in the full analysis set (randomized and dosed).
    synonyms:
      - fas
      - full analysis set
      - fas flag

  - name: In PPS
    expr: PPSFL
    comment: Y if the participant is in the per-protocol set (FAS without a major
      protocol deviation).
    synonyms:
      - pps
      - per protocol
      - per-protocol set

measures:
  - name: Participants Evaluated
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT(1) END
    comment: Randomized participants with a result row under the rule version in scope.
    synonyms:
      - participants
      - randomized participants
      - "n"

  - name: Participants In FAS
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y')
      END
    comment: Participants in the full analysis set (the endpoint population).
    synonyms:
      - fas count
      - analysis population count
      - population size

  - name: Participants With Valid Baseline
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND baseline_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a valid baseline weight under the rule version.
    synonyms:
      - valid baseline
      - has baseline
      - baseline available

  - name: Participants With Qualifying Week 24 Observation
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND followup_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a follow-up weight inside the rule version's Week
      24 analysis window.
    synonyms:
      - qualifying week 24
      - week 24 observation
      - in window
      - evaluable week 24

  - name: Participants With Derived Endpoint
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND result_status = 'DERIVED') END
    comment: FAS participants with a derived percent change (valid baseline AND qualifying
      follow-up).
    synonyms:
      - derived
      - evaluable
      - with result
      - completers at week 24

  - name: Endpoint Missingness Rate
    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN 1 - COUNT_IF(FASFL\
      \ = 'Y' AND result_status = 'DERIVED') / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'), 0) END"
    comment: Share of FAS participants with no derived endpoint (no imputation is
      done).
    synonyms:
      - missingness
      - missing rate
      - missing data rate
      - percent missing

  - name: Mean Percent Change
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN AVG(CASE WHEN FASFL
      = 'Y' THEN PCHG END) END
    comment: Mean percent change in body weight among FAS participants with a derived
      result (unrounded; negative = weight loss). Descriptive; synthetic.
    synonyms:
      - mean change
      - average percent change
      - mean weight change
      - mean pchg

  - name: Median Percent Change
    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE\
      \ WHEN FASFL = 'Y' THEN PCHG END, 0.5) END"
    comment: Median percent change among FAS

Excluded observations in eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_candidate include decision = 'EXCLUDED' and are measured as COUNT_IF(gold_endpoint_candidate.decision = 'EXCLUDED'). Follow-up candidates, also called 'week 24 candidates', include role = 'FOLLOWUP'. ## CSL-A-103-0137: Excluded From the Per-Protocol Set Due to a History of Acute Pancreatitis

Participant **CSL-A-103-0137** was excluded from the CSL-A per-protocol set (PPS) because of a **major eligibility violation** — specifically, a medical history of **acute pancreatitis**, which triggered the exclusion criterion **EXC-MH** ("History of an exclusionary condition"). [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-6478c9bd-1674-4de3-98dd-5f51fa32ff7f)

### Population Flags

| Flag | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **FASFL** | Y | In the Full Analysis Set (randomized and dosed) |
| **PPSFL** | N | **Excluded** from the Per-Protocol Set |
| **Reconciliation** | ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE | Enrolled despite not meeting the eligibility rule |
| **EDC eligible** | Y | Site recorded the participant as eligible in EDC |
| **Rule eligible** | false | Automated rule engine determined ineligibility |

<!-- begin-embedded:query_tc6CmN -->
| USUBJID | STUDYID | ARMCD | SITEID | FASFL | PPSFL | reconciliation | deviations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CSL-A-103-0137 | CSL-A | CSL101 | SITE-103 | Y | N | ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE | [{"deviation":"ELIGIBILITY_VIOLATION","path":[],"evidence":"EXC-MH","severity":"MAJOR","drug":null}] |
<!-- end-embedded:query_tc6CmN -->

The participant was randomized to the **CSL101** arm at **SITE-103** under protocol version **2.0** (eligibility rule **ELIG-A-V2**). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e7419adc40204f75b0bade2a2337a278?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_5f8cf3)

### Criterion-Level Traceability

The eligibility engine evaluated all five CSL-A criteria for this participant: [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/e7419adc40204f75b0bade2a2337a278?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_9bc1f5)

| Criterion | Type | Outcome | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| INC-AGE | Inclusion | MET | age = 40 |
| INC-BMI | Inclusion | MET | BMI 39.83 ≥ 30 |
| **EXC-MH** | **Exclusion** | **TRIGGERED** | **acute pancreatitis is\_a\* pancreatitis** |
| EXC-CI | Exclusion | NOT_TRIGGERED | — |
| EXC-CM | Exclusion | NOT_TRIGGERED | — |

The failing criterion was **EXC-MH**: the participant's medical history record (`EDC-MH-CSL-A-103-0137-1`) documented **acute pancreatitis** (MONDO:0006515), which subsumes to **pancreatitis** (MONDO:0004982) via the ontology closure — a condition on the exclusionary medical-history list (class `EXCL-MH-V1`). [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### Why the Discrepancy?

The site recorded the participant as eligible in EDC (`edc_eligible = Y`), but the rule-based eligibility engine flagged them as ineligible (`rule_eligible = false`). This **ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE** reconciliation status means the participant was enrolled in error — the site missed the exclusionary medical history. Because the PPS excludes all FAS participants with a major protocol deviation, this eligibility violation removed CSL-A-103-0137 from the per-protocol set. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-67638385-4c7a-4e23-909e-0728bf7c0d4d) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-b3040256-583a-41a0-9079-e2c488b7f297)

UC metric view eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.participant_population_metrics (query measures with MEASURE(`<measure name>`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.participant_population_metrics):
version: 1.1

source: eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population

comment: "One row per screened participant: rule-based eligibility at the protocol\
  \ version in force at screening, randomization, FAS/PPS membership, and EDC-vs-rule\
  \ reconciliation (SYNTHETIC). Measures are NULL unless exactly one `Study` is in\
  \ scope."

dimensions:
  - name: Study
    expr: STUDYID
    comment: Study identifier (CSL-A or CSL-B).
    synonyms:
      - study
      - trial

  - name: Protocol Version At Screening
    expr: protocol_version
    comment: Protocol version in force on the screening date; decides which eligibility
      rule applies.
    synonyms:
      - protocol version
      - screening protocol version

  - name: Eligibility Rule
    expr: eligibility_rule_id
    comment: "Approved eligibility rule version applied (ELIG-A-V1, ELIG-A-V2, ELIG-B-V1)."
    synonyms:
      - eligibility rule
      - criteria version

  - name: Arm
    expr: ARMCD
    comment: Randomized arm (CSL101 or PBO); empty for screen failures.
    synonyms:
      - arm
      - treatment arm

  - name: Site
    expr: SITEID
    comment: Investigational site.
    synonyms:
      - site
      - center

  - name: Reconciliation
    expr: reconciliation
    comment: "CONSISTENT, ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE (enrolled in error) or RULE_ELIGIBLE_BUT_NOT_ENROLLED\
      \ (non-protocol screen failure)."
    synonyms:
      - reconciliation
      - eligibility reconciliation
      - enrolled in error

measures:
  - name: Screened Participants
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT(1) END
    comment: Participants screened.
    synonyms:
      - screened
      - screening count

  - name: Rule Eligible Participants
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(rule_eligible) END
    comment: "Participants who meet every criterion of the applicable eligibility\
      \ rule, as derived from the ontology (not as recorded by the site)."
    synonyms:
      - eligible
      - rule eligible
      - meets criteria

  - name: Randomized Participants
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(randomized) END
    comment: Participants randomized.
    synonyms:
      - randomized
      - enrolled

  - name: FAS Participants
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y') END
    comment: "Full analysis set: randomized and dosed."
    synonyms:
      - fas
      - full analysis set

  - name: PPS Participants
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(PPSFL = 'Y') END
    comment: "Per-protocol set: FAS without a major protocol deviation."
    synonyms:
      - pps
      - per protocol set

  - name: Enrolled In Error
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(reconciliation = 'ENROLLED_BUT_RULE_INELIGIBLE')
      END
    comment: Randomized although the applicable eligibility rule is not met (an eligibility-violation
      deviation).
    synonyms:
      - enrolled in error
      - eligibility violations
      - ineligible enrolled

  - name: Participants With Major Deviation
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT STUDYID) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y' AND PPSFL
      = 'N') END
    comment: FAS participants excluded from the PPS by a major protocol deviation
      (eligibility violation or prohibited medication on treatment).
    synonyms:
      - major deviations
      - protocol deviations
      - pps exclusions

query.sql:
WITH v2_crit AS (
  SELECT criterion_id
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.eligibility_criterion
  WHERE class_id = 'WRC-V2'
),
v1_crit AS (
  SELECT criterion_id
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.eligibility_criterion
  WHERE class_id = 'WRC-V1'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gec.USUBJID) AS participant_count
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_eligibility_criterion gec
JOIN v2_crit ON gec.criterion_id = v2_crit.criterion_id
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
  ON gec.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_vs vs
  ON gec.USUBJID = vs.USUBJID
 AND vs.VSTESTCD = 'BMI'
WHERE gec.rule_eligible = true
  AND dm.DMDTC BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-10-31'
  AND vs.VSSTRESN >= 27
  AND vs.VSSTRESN < 30
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_eligibility_criterion gec1
    JOIN v1_crit ON gec1.criterion_id = v1_crit.criterion_id
    WHERE gec1.USUBJID = gec.USUBJID
      AND gec1.rule_eligible = true
  )

## 60 Participants Qualified for CSL-A Solely via the Amendment 1 OSA Addition

Among CSL-A participants screened from **2025-10-27 through 2026-10-31** with a BMI of 27 to under 30, **60** met the BMI inclusion criterion only because Amendment 1 added obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) as a weight-related comorbidity. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/0b5b97f1ca3d40a5b6f7984af842f6f6?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_8de799)

### How this was determined

The INC-BMI criterion requires either BMI ≥ 30 alone, or BMI ≥ 27 with at least one weight-related comorbidity. [Weight-related comorbidity class (WRC-V1 / WRC-V2)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/ef6ec006-308e-475e-8bb5-ba22778d76cd?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0, effective 2025-10-27) expanded the comorbidity class from **WRC-V1** to **WRC-V2**, adding obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (MONDO:0007147) as a new root — the only addition. [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

To isolate participants who qualified **only** because of this change:

1. **252 participants** screened in the date range had BMI in [27, 30) and met INC-BMI under ELIG-A-V2 with a WRC-V2 comorbidity.
2. Each participant's medical history (`silver_mh`) was checked against the full WRC-V1 membership set (MONDO closure with carve-outs applied). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-89a7dc7e-06b2-4ee4-b025-62f6045be5e0)
3. **192** of the 252 also carried at least one WRC-V1 condition (e.g., hypertension, T2DM, hyperlipidemia) — they would have qualified under the original protocol regardless.
4. The remaining **60** had OSA as their sole qualifying comorbidity and no WRC-V1 member in their history — they met the criterion exclusively because Amendment 1 added OSA. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/0b5b97f1ca3d40a5b6f7984af842f6f6?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_16416b)

source: "SELECT a.*, d.SITEID, d.ARMCD, concat('EP-A-WT24.', a.from_rule_version,\

## SITE-118's Week 24 Visits Were Late Due to Systematic Scheduling Delays at a High-Enrolling Site

The protocol amendment document (CSL-A-PROT-AMD1 §1) provides the definitive explanation: **Week 24 visits at a high-enrolling site were often scheduled 8 to 13 days late**, identified during routine site monitoring in September 2025. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/266351efbab646218cf29e44650d5b5c?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_d03700) This left otherwise complete participants without an evaluable endpoint under the original ±7-day analysis window (EP-A-WT24.R1). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-72186c3e-544f-4381-a52c-dbb4d27b3832)

### No Monitoring Visit Reports Exist in This System

The document library contains only **PROTOCOL, AMENDMENT, SAP, NOTE, and SPEC** document types — no monitoring visit reports (MVRs) or site-level operational records. [Clinical Study Lab — Protocol Evidence (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae6816ea9dfd855351a858ff?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) The closest source is the **Amendment 1 rationale** in CSL-A-PROT-AMD1 §1, which references the monitoring finding without reproducing the MVR itself.

### Scale of the Problem at SITE-118

Of **140 participants** at SITE-118 with a labeled WEEK 24 visit, **98 (70%)** had their visit fall outside the original ±7-day window — all running **+8 to +13 days late**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/266351efbab646218cf29e44650d5b5c?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_27ad63) Only 42 participants had on-time visits (within ±4 days of target).

<!-- begin-embedded:query_27ad63 -->
| visit_timing | participants | min_days | max_days | avg_days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Late (>7 days) | 98 | 8 | 13 | 10.6 |
| On time (±7 days) | 42 | -4 | 4 | 0.4 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_27ad63 -->

### Distribution of Late Visits

The lateness was tightly clustered, consistent with a site-level scheduling pattern rather than individual participant issues: [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

| Days Late | Participants |
|---|---|
| +8 | 15 |
| +9 | 13 |
| +10 | 16 |
| +11 | 22 |
| +12 | 15 |
| +13 | 17 |

### How Amendment 1 Resolved It

Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0, effective 2025-10-27) widened the Week 24 analysis window from **±7 to ±14 days** (CSL-A-SAP-v2.0 §9.4.1), specifically to recover these participants. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-8cf7d79a-9162-4dd7-95b2-1cd395a59ccf) Under the amended rule (EP-A-WT24.R2), all **98 previously non-evaluable participants** became derivable — their Week 24 observations, which had been excluded as `OUTSIDE_FOLLOWUP_WINDOW` under R1, were selected as `FOLLOWUP_CLOSEST_TO_TARGET` under R2. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514)

### Key Takeaway

The amendment rationale explicitly attributes the late visits to a **scheduling pattern at a high-enrolling site** caught during routine monitoring. The data confirms SITE-118 is that site: it accounts for the vast majority of participants recovered by Amendment 1, with a distinctive +8 to +13 day lateness band that matches the amendment's stated finding. [Baseline and visit-window rules](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/5234158c-899d-46f6-ba1d-98e51d9532ec?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

*Synthetic data — not submission-ready and not for clinical use.*

SQL Genie One ran:

-- Summary: SITE-118 participants by whether their Week 24 visit was late (>7 days from target) under R1
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN ec.days_from_target > 7 THEN 'Late (>7 days)'
    WHEN ec.days_from_target BETWEEN -7 AND 7 THEN 'On time (±7 days)'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS visit_timing,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ec.USUBJID) AS participants,
  MIN(ec.days_from_target) AS min_days,
  MAX(ec.days_from_target) AS max_days,
  ROUND(AVG(ec.days_from_target), 1) AS avg_days
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_candidate` ec
JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_participant_population` pp
  ON ec.USUBJID = pp.USUBJID
WHERE pp.SITEID = 'SITE-118'
  AND ec.role = 'FOLLOWUP'
  AND ec.rule_version = 'R1'
  AND ec.visit = 'WEEK 24'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`doc_section`
WHERE `document_id` = 'CSL-A-PROT-AMD1'
ORDER BY `section_number`

## CSL-A Body Weight: Storage, Units, and Governing Rule Version

### 1. Where body weight is stored

Raw body-weight observations live in **`silver_vs`** (the SDTM VS domain), filtered by `VSTESTCD = 'WEIGHT'`. [eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_vs](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/eli_test_classic_catalog/clinical_study/silver_vs?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-ce9b019c-07b1-4723-91ab-62e48f168291)

The derived Week 24 analysis results (one row per participant × endpoint rule version) are in **`gold_endpoint_result`**, which carries the baseline weight (`BASE`), follow-up weight (`AVAL_FU`), and percent change (`PCHG`). [eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/eli_test_classic_catalog/clinical_study/gold_endpoint_result?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### 2. Analysis-value unit

All analysis values are in **kilograms (kg)**. [Unit normalization (body weight)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/2a363ebb-4203-4002-81ad-8e8fcff7555d?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

- In `silver_vs`, the standardized numeric result `VSSTRESN` is always kg (LB × 0.45359237; g × 0.001). The allowed raw units (`VSORRESU`) are LB, g, and kg; any other raw unit is flagged `UNMAPPED_RAW_UNIT` and excluded from the endpoint.
- In `gold_endpoint_result`, `BASE` and `AVAL_FU` are both in kg; `PCHG` is the unrounded percent change: 100 × (AVAL\_FU − BASE) / BASE. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-f0e6805a-69a8-4a0c-a932-d3505bae2733) [Endpoint definitions (Week 24 weight change)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/81946aa1-f832-4edd-a734-c373cddba9a3?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

### 3. Endpoint rule version governing Week 24 results through 2026-10-31

**EP-A-WT24.R2** — the Amendment 1 rule — governs. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514)

Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0) became effective **2025-10-27**, well before the 2026-10-31 data cutoff. R2 was approved on **2025-10-20** and amends R1. The only analysis-relevant change was widening the Week 24 follow-up window from **±7 days** (R1) to **±14 days** (R2) around the target date (study day 169). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/91c1d3e642e2481b8c0ee7d44cf2a908?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_284697) [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/91c1d3e642e2481b8c0ee7d44cf2a908?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_e7df6e)

Both rule versions are present in the result data (R1 has 3,350 derived results; R2 has 3,525), but per the study's reporting rules, results must never be pooled across rule versions. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/91c1d3e642e2481b8c0ee7d44cf2a908?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_ea487a) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-314cfef0-048a-4696-a962-2aeaf36a47b9)

WITH RECURSIVE seed AS (
  SELECT object AS disease, 'root' AS kind
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'
    AND predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasRoot'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT object AS disease, 'excl' AS kind
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'
    AND predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/excludesRoot'
),
desc_cte AS (
  SELECT disease, kind FROM seed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.subject AS disease, d.kind
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph t
  JOIN desc_cte d ON t.object = d.disease
  WHERE t.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
),
valid_diseases AS (
  SELECT disease FROM desc_cte WHERE kind = 'root'
  EXCEPT
  SELECT disease FROM desc_cte WHERE kind = 'excl'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject) AS n_randomized_with_wrc_mh
FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph p
WHERE p.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/randomizationDate'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph hmh
    JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph ca
      ON ca.subject = hmh.object
     AND ca.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/codedAs'
    WHERE hmh.subject = p.subject
      AND hmh.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasMedicalHistory'
      AND ca.object IN (SELECT disease FROM valid_diseases)
  )

WITH RECURSIVE wrc_diseases AS (
    SELECT object AS disease
    FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
    WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'
      AND predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasRoot'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT t.subject AS disease
    FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph t
    JOIN wrc_diseases w
      ON t.object = w.disease
     AND t.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
),
randomized_participants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT subject AS participant
    FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
    WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/randomizationDate'
),
mh_diseases AS (
    SELECT
        hmh.subject AS participant,
        ca.object AS disease
    FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph hmh
    JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph ca
      ON hmh.object = ca.subject
     AND ca.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/codedAs'
    WHERE hmh.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasMedicalHistory'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rp.participant) AS n_participants_with_weight_related_comorbidity
FROM randomized_participants rp
JOIN mh_diseases md
  ON md.participant = rp.participant
JOIN wrc_diseases wd

WITH RECURSIVE g AS (
  SELECT subject, predicate, object
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
),
subclass_closure AS (
  SELECT subject AS disease, subject AS ancestor
  FROM g
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
  UNION
  SELECT object AS disease, object AS ancestor
  FROM g
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.disease, tt.object AS ancestor
  FROM subclass_closure c
  JOIN g tt
    ON c.ancestor = tt.subject
   AND tt.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
),
wrc_roots AS (
  SELECT object AS root
  FROM g
  WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'

),
wrc_excludes AS (
  SELECT object AS excl

  WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'
    AND predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/excludesRoot'
),
matching_diseases AS (

WITH weight_obs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject AS obs_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/conformsTo'
    AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/DatasetSpecialization/COSMOS_DSS:WEIGHT'
),
storage AS (
  SELECT 'WeightObservation records (conformsTo DatasetSpecialization COSMOS_DSS:WEIGHT, measures Body Weight)' AS storage_location
),
units AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ct.object AS unit_code
  FROM weight_obs wo
  JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph hu
    ON wo.obs_iri = hu.subject AND hu.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasUnit'
  JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph ct
    ON hu.object = ct.subject AND ct.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/code'
),
results AS (
  SELECT du.subject AS result_iri,
         try_cast(td.object AS DATE) AS target_date,
         du.object AS rule_version_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph du
  JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph td
    ON du.subject = td.subject AND td.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/targetDate'
  WHERE du.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/derivedUnder'
),
endpoint_rule AS (
  SELECT subject AS rule_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/versionOfEndpoint'
    AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/EndpointDefinition/EP-A-WT24'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.rule_version_iri
  FROM results r
  JOIN endpoint_rule er ON r.rule_version_iri = er.rule_iri
  WHERE r.target_date <= DATE'2026-10-31'
),
rule_versions AS (
  SELECT rv.object AS rule_version_label
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph rv
    ON f.rule_version_iri = rv.subject AND rv.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ruleVersion'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT storage_location FROM storage) AS storage_location,
  (SELECT concat_ws(', ', collect_set(unit_code)) FROM units) AS analysis_value_unit,
  (SELECT concat_ws(', ', collect_set(rule_version_label)) FROM rule_versions) AS week24_rule_version

WITH part AS (
  SELECT 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/Participant/CSL-A-103-0137' AS pid
)
SELECT
  dev.object        AS protocol_deviation,
  devtype.object    AS deviation_type,
  sev.object        AS deviation_severity,
  violcrit.object   AS violated_criterion_iri,
  critparams.object AS criterion_parameters,
  fails.object      AS fails_criterion_iri,
  mh.object         AS medical_history_record,
  disease.object    AS coded_disease
FROM part
JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph dev
  ON dev.subject = part.pid
 AND dev.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasDeviation'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph devtype
  ON devtype.subject = dev.object
 AND devtype.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/deviationType'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph sev
  ON sev.subject = dev.object
 AND sev.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/severity'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph violcrit
  ON violcrit.subject = dev.object
 AND violcrit.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/violatesCriterion'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph critparams
  ON critparams.subject = violcrit.object
 AND critparams.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/parameters'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph fails
  ON fails.subject = part.pid
 AND fails.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/failsCriterion'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph mh
  ON mh.subject = part.pid
 AND mh.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasMedicalHistory'
LEFT JOIN eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph disease
  ON disease.subject = mh.object
 AND disease.predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/codedAs'

  SELECT subject, predicate, object
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph

subclass(d, anc) AS (
  SELECT subject, object
  FROM triples
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/subClassOf'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.d, t2.object
  FROM subclass s
  JOIN triples t2
    ON s.anc = t2.subject

v1_roots AS (
  SELECT object AS disease

),
v1_excludes AS (
  SELECT object AS disease
  FROM triples
  WHERE subject = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/ConceptClass/WRC-V1'

),
v1_qualifying AS (

UC metric view eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics (query measures with MEASURE(`<measure name>`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics):
version: 1.1

source: "SELECT r.*, p.ARMCD, p.SITEID, p.COUNTRY, p.FASFL, p.PPSFL FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result\
  \ r JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p USING\
  \ (USUBJID)"

comment: "Week 24 percent change in body weight from baseline, one row per randomized\
  \ participant x endpoint rule version (SYNTHETIC; ADaM-shaped, not submission-ready).\
  \ Every measure is NULL unless exactly one rule version is in scope: always filter\
  \ or group by `Rule Version`. Descriptive only; not evidence of efficacy."

dimensions:
  - name: Study
    expr: STUDYID
    comment: "Study identifier: CSL-A (72-week obesity study) or CSL-B (52-week type\
      \ 2 diabetes study)."
    synonyms:
      - study
      - study id
      - trial
      - protocol

  - name: Rule Version
    expr: endpoint_version
    comment: "Executable endpoint rule version: EP-A-WT24.R1 (±7 days), EP-A-WT24.R2\
      \ (±14 days, Amendment 1), EP-B-WT24.R1 (mean baseline, ±10 days). Required\
      \ for every measure."
    synonyms:
      - rule version
      - endpoint version
      - definition version
      - R1
      - R2
      - analysis window version

  - name: Protocol Version
    expr: protocol_version
    comment: "Protocol version the rule version implements (1.0, 2.0)."
    synonyms:
      - protocol version
      - amendment

  - name: SAP Version
    expr: sap_version
    comment: Statistical analysis plan version the rule version implements.
    synonyms:
      - sap version
      - analysis plan version

  - name: Arm
    expr: ARMCD
    comment: "Randomized arm: CSL101 (CSL-101 10 mg once weekly) or PBO (placebo)."
    synonyms:
      - arm
      - treatment arm
      - treatment group
      - randomized arm

  - name: Site
    expr: SITEID
    comment: Investigational site.
    synonyms:
      - site
      - center
      - investigator site

  - name: Country
    expr: COUNTRY
    comment: Site country (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
    synonyms:
      - country
      - region

  - name: Result Status
    expr: result_status
    comment: "DERIVED, NO_VALID_BASELINE, NO_QUALIFYING_FOLLOWUP, NO_REFERENCE_DATE\
      \ or NOT_IN_POPULATION."
    synonyms:
      - status
      - result status
      - derivation status
      - evaluable

  - name: Exclusion Reason
    expr: exclusion_reason
    comment: "Why no endpoint was derived, e.g. NO_OBSERVATION_IN_WINDOW:closest_+10d\
      \ (the closest follow-up was 10 days after the target)."
    synonyms:
      - reason
      - exclusion reason
      - missing reason
      - why not derived

  - name: In FAS
    expr: FASFL
    comment: Y if the participant is in the full analysis set (randomized and dosed).
    synonyms:
      - fas
      - full analysis set
      - fas flag

  - name: In PPS
    expr: PPSFL
    comment: Y if the participant is in the per-protocol set (FAS without a major
      protocol deviation).
    synonyms:
      - pps
      - per protocol
      - per-protocol set

measures:
  - name: Participants Evaluated
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT(1) END
    comment: Randomized participants with a result row under the rule version in scope.
    synonyms:
      - participants
      - randomized participants
      - "n"

  - name: Participants In FAS
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y')
      END
    comment: Participants in the full analysis set (the endpoint population).
    synonyms:
      - fas count
      - analysis population count
      - population size

  - name: Participants With Valid Baseline
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND baseline_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a valid baseline weight under the rule version.
    synonyms:
      - valid baseline
      - has baseline
      - baseline available

  - name: Participants With Qualifying Week 24 Observation
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND followup_observation_id IS NOT NULL) END
    comment: FAS participants with a follow-up weight inside the rule version's Week
      24 analysis window.
    synonyms:
      - qualifying week 24
      - week 24 observation
      - in window
      - evaluable week 24

  - name: Participants With Derived Endpoint
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'
      AND result_status = 'DERIVED') END
    comment: FAS participants with a derived percent change (valid baseline AND qualifying
      follow-up).
    synonyms:
      - derived
      - evaluable
      - with result
      - completers at week 24

  - name: Endpoint Missingness Rate
    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN 1 - COUNT_IF(FASFL\
      \ = 'Y' AND result_status = 'DERIVED') / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(FASFL = 'Y'), 0) END"
    comment: Share of FAS participants with no derived endpoint (no imputation is
      done).
    synonyms:
      - missingness
      - missing rate
      - missing data rate
      - percent missing

  - name: Mean Percent Change
    expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN AVG(CASE WHEN FASFL

    comment: Mean percent change in body weight among FAS participants with a derived

    synonyms:

      - mean weight change
      - mean pchg

  - name: Median Percent Change
    expr: "CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT endpoint_version) = 1 THEN PERCENTILE_APPROX(CASE\

    comment: Median percent change among FAS

## CSL-A Mean Percent Change in Body Weight — Week 24, Protocol 2.0 (EP-A-WT24.R2)

Under the **protocol 2.0 / SAP v2.0** rule (EP-A-WT24.R2, ±14-day analysis window, Amendment 1), the mean percent change in body weight from baseline to Week 24 in the **FAS population** for data through 2026-10-31 is: [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514)

| Arm | FAS (N) | Derived (n) | Mean % Change |
|-----|---------|-------------|---------------|
| **CSL101** (CSL-101 10 mg QW) | 2,772 | 2,410 | **−12.66%** |
| **PBO** (Placebo) | 1,271 | 1,115 | **−2.30%** |

<!-- begin-embedded:query_007c1f -->
| Arm | n_fas | n_derived | mean_pct_change | missingness |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CSL101 | 2772 | 2410 | -12.66 | 0.131 |
| PBO | 1271 | 1115 | -2.3 | 0.123 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_007c1f -->

### Key details

- **Rule version**: EP-A-WT24.R2 — the ±14-day Week 24 window introduced by Amendment 1 (protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-8cf7d79a-9162-4dd7-95b2-1cd395a59ccf)
- **Population**: Full Analysis Set (FAS — randomized and dosed); mean is computed over participants with a derived endpoint only. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-f0e6805a-69a8-4a0c-a932-d3505bae2733)
- **Missingness**: ~13.1% (CSL101) and ~12.3% (PBO) of FAS participants had no derived endpoint (no imputation). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/1e4c20d426df40f38b084a533ca1e830?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_007c1f)
- **Data cutoff**: All FAS participants' Week 24 target dates fall on or before 2026-10-31, so the full dataset is included in this cut. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/1e4c20d426df40f38b084a533ca1e830?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_oujFcY)
- Negative values indicate weight loss. Results are **descriptive only** (synthetic data; not evidence of efficacy). [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-cf3beb25-95e9-4acd-a91b-6de48daad2a7)

Results were sourced from the **Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics** Genie space [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) and cross-validated against the governed metric view [eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/explore/data/eli_test_classic_catalog/clinical_study_semantic/endpoint_result_metrics?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) and the pre-computed study summary table. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/1e4c20d426df40f38b084a533ca1e830?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_449421)

SELECT * FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_study_summary WHERE STUDYID = 'CSL-A' AND rule_version = 'R2'

SELECT DISTINCT execution_run_id, engine_version, terminology_version FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result WHERE STUDYID = 'CSL-A' AND endpoint_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R2' LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  `Arm`,
  MEASURE(`Participants In FAS`) AS `n_fas`,
  MEASURE(`Participants With Derived Endpoint`) AS `n_derived`,
  ROUND(MEASURE(`Mean Percent Change`), 2) AS `mean_pct_change`,
  ROUND(MEASURE(`Endpoint Missingness Rate`), 3) AS `missingness`
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_semantic.endpoint_result_metrics
WHERE `Rule Version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Arm`

query.sql:
WITH bmi_base AS (
  SELECT
    v.USUBJID,
    v.VSSTRESN AS BMI,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.USUBJID ORDER BY v.VSDY ASC) AS rn
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_vs v
  WHERE v.VSTESTCD = 'BMI'
),
bmi_baseline AS (
  SELECT USUBJID, BMI
  FROM bmi_base
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.ARMCD,
  AVG(e.PCHG) AS mean_pct_change_body_weight
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_endpoint_result e
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_participant_population p
  ON e.USUBJID = p.USUBJID
 AND e.STUDYID = p.STUDYID
JOIN bmi_baseline b
  ON b.USUBJID = e.USUBJID
WHERE e.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
  AND e.rule_version = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
  AND e.protocol_version = '2.0'
  AND p.FASFL = 'Y'
  AND b.BMI >= 35
GROUP BY p.ARMCD
ORDER BY p.ARMCD

WITH ep AS (
  SELECT subject AS result_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'derivedUnder'
    AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/EndpointRuleVersion/EP-A-WT24.R2'
),
pct AS (
  SELECT subject AS result_iri, try_cast(object AS DOUBLE) AS pct_change
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'percentChange'
),
bl AS (
  SELECT subject AS result_iri, try_cast(object AS DOUBLE) AS baseline_kg
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'baselineKg'
),
fp AS (
  SELECT subject AS result_iri, object AS participant_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'forParticipant'
),
arm AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant_iri, object AS arm_code
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'armCode'
),
fas AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'inPopulation'
    AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/AnalysisPopulation/FAS'
),
hobs AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant_iri, object AS height_obs_iri
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'hasObservation'
),
hcm AS (
  SELECT subject AS height_obs_iri, try_cast(object AS DOUBLE) AS height_cm
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
  WHERE predicate = 'standardValueCm'
)
SELECT
  a.arm_code,
  AVG(pc.pct_change) AS mean_percent_change_body_weight
FROM ep
JOIN fp  ON fp.result_iri = ep.result_iri
JOIN pct pc ON pc.result_iri = ep.result_iri
JOIN bl  ON bl.result_iri = ep.result_iri
JOIN arm a ON a.participant_iri = fp.participant_iri
JOIN fas ON fas.participant_iri = fp.participant_iri
JOIN hobs ON hobs.participant_iri = fp.participant_iri
JOIN hcm ON hcm.height_obs_iri = hobs.height_obs_iri
WHERE bl.baseline_kg / POWER(hcm.height_cm / 100.0, 2) >= 35
GROUP BY a.arm_code
ORDER BY a.arm_code

## CSL-A BMI ≥ 35 Subgroup: Mean % Change in Body Weight at Week 24 (Protocol 2.0)

Among **CSL-A full-analysis-set participants with baseline BMI ≥ 35** and a derived Week 24 result under the **protocol 2.0 rule** (EP-A-WT24.R2, ±14-day window), the mean percent change in body weight from baseline was: [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-e14628c5-7a89-40dd-9447-1fbaad365514) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-f0e6805a-69a8-4a0c-a932-d3505bae2733)

| Arm | N | Mean % Change | Mean Baseline BMI |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CSL101** (CSL-101 10 mg QW) | 893 | **−12.74%** | 40.8 |
| **PBO** (Placebo) | 405 | **−2.30%** | 40.4 |

<!-- begin-embedded:query_eb6c8e -->
| arm | n_participants | mean_pct_change | mean_baseline_bmi |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CSL101 | 893 | -12.74 | 40.8 |
| PBO | 405 | -2.3 | 40.4 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_eb6c8e -->

### Key details

- **Population**: FAS participants (`analysis_population_status = 'IN_FAS'`) with a derived endpoint (`result_status = 'DERIVED'`), filtered to those whose baseline BMI ≥ 35. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-67638385-4c7a-4e23-909e-0728bf7c0d4d)
- **BMI calculation**: Baseline weight (kg) from `gold_endpoint_result.BASE` divided by height (m)² from the screening height in `silver_vs`. Height is recorded once per participant at screening, in cm. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/c3314220640e4f9687075e0ceea44e90?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_eb6c8e)
- **Rule version**: EP-A-WT24.R2 corresponds to protocol 2.0 / SAP 2.0 (Amendment 1), which widened the Week 24 analysis window from ±7 to ±14 days. [Protocol amendments (CSL-A)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/49392558-5839-44cb-ad4d-15acd5ff5d4c?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)
- **Data cut (2026-10-31)**: All derived follow-up observations in this dataset fall on or before 2026-07-04, so the 2026-10-31 cutoff does not exclude any participants. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/c3314220640e4f9687075e0ceea44e90?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_591dad)
- **Subgroup size**: The BMI ≥ 35 subgroup comprises 893 of 2,410 CSL101 FAS-derived participants (37%) and 405 of 1,115 PBO FAS-derived participants (36%). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/c3314220640e4f9687075e0ceea44e90?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_4a9756)

*Note: BMI is not stored directly in the gold endpoint or population tables — it was computed by joining screening height from `silver_vs` with baseline weight from `gold_endpoint_result`. This is synthetic, descriptive data; results do not imply efficacy or a causal effect.* [Clinical Study Lab — Study Analytics (ect)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1e12bae801258850ed21912b26813?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-cf3beb25-95e9-4acd-a91b-6de48daad2a7)

SQL Genie One ran:
SELECT VSTESTCD, VSSTRESU, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(VSSTRESN) AS min_val, MAX(VSSTRESN) AS max_val
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs`
WHERE `STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND `VSTESTCD` = 'HEIGHT'
GROUP BY `VSTESTCD`, `VSSTRESU`

SELECT MIN(`reference_date`) AS min_ref, MAX(`reference_date`) AS max_ref,
       MIN(`followup_target_date`) AS min_fu_target, MAX(`followup_target_date`) AS max_fu_target
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result`
WHERE `STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND `endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `USUBJID`) AS participants_with_height,
       COUNT(*) AS total_height_records,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT `USUBJID`), 2) AS records_per_participant
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs`
WHERE `STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND `VSTESTCD` = 'HEIGHT'

SELECT MAX(vs.`VSDTC`) AS max_followup_obs_date
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result` er
JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs` vs
  ON er.`followup_observation_id` = vs.`CPL_OBS_ID`
WHERE er.`STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND er.`endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
  AND er.`result_status` = 'DERIVED'

WITH height AS (
  SELECT `USUBJID`, `VSSTRESN` AS height_cm
  FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`silver_vs`
  WHERE `STUDYID` = 'CSL-A' AND `VSTESTCD` = 'HEIGHT'
),
endpoint AS (
  SELECT er.`USUBJID`,
         pp.`ARMCD`,
         er.`BASE`,
         er.`PCHG`,
         er.`result_status`,
         er.`analysis_population_status`
  FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result` er
  JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_participant_population` pp
    ON er.`USUBJID` = pp.`USUBJID`
  WHERE er.`STUDYID` = 'CSL-A'
    AND er.`endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'
    AND er.`analysis_population_status` = 'IN_FAS'
    AND er.`result_status` = 'DERIVED'
)
SELECT e.`ARMCD` AS arm,
       COUNT(*) AS n_participants,
       ROUND(AVG(e.`PCHG`), 2) AS mean_pct_change,
       ROUND(AVG(e.`BASE` / POWER(h.`height_cm` / 100.0, 2)), 1) AS mean_baseline_bmi
FROM endpoint e
JOIN height h ON e.`USUBJID` = h.`USUBJID`
WHERE (e.`BASE` / POWER(h.`height_cm` / 100.0, 2)) >= 35
GROUP BY e.`ARMCD`
ORDER BY e.`ARMCD`

SELECT pp.`ARMCD` AS arm,
       COUNT(*) AS n_fas_derived
FROM `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_endpoint_result` er
JOIN `eli_test_classic_catalog`.`clinical_study`.`gold_participant_population` pp
  ON er.`USUBJID` = pp.`USUBJID`
WHERE er.`STUDYID` = 'CSL-A'
  AND er.`endpoint_version` = 'EP-A-WT24.R2'

query.sql:
WITH prohibited_rxnorm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT split(subject, ':')[1] AS rxnorm_id
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge
  WHERE (predicate = 'medrt:memberOf' AND object = 'MEDRT:N0000178480')
     OR (predicate = 'medrt:has_PE' AND object = 'MEDRT:N0000175372')
)
SELECT
  dm.ARMCD,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.USUBJID) AS n_participants_with_prohibited_med
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm dm
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_cm cm
  ON cm.USUBJID = dm.USUBJID
 AND cm.STUDYID = dm.STUDYID
JOIN prohibited_rxnorm pr
  ON cm.CPL_RXNORM_ID = pr.rxnorm_id
WHERE dm.STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
  AND dm.RFXSTDTC IS NOT NULL
  AND cm.CMSTDTC IS NOT NULL
  AND cm.CMSTDTC >= dm.RFXSTDTC
  AND cm.CMSTDTC <= '2026-10-31'
GROUP BY dm.ARMCD
ORDER BY dm.ARMCD

query.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT subject, predicate, object
  FROM eswanson_demo.ontobricks.triplestore_clinicalstudylab_v6_graph
),
csla_participants AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/screenedFor'
    AND object   = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/Study/CSL-A'
),
arm AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant, object AS arm_code
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/armCode'
),
first_dose AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant, try_cast(object AS DATE) AS first_dose_date
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/firstDoseDateTime'
),
conmed_link AS (
  SELECT subject AS participant, object AS conmed
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasConMed'
),
conmed_drug AS (
  SELECT subject AS conmed, object AS drug
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/codedAs'
),
conmed_start AS (
  SELECT subject AS conmed, try_cast(object AS DATE) AS start_date
  FROM t
  WHERE predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/startDate'
),
prohibited_drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject AS drug
  FROM t
  WHERE (predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/memberOfClass'
         AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/DrugClass/MEDRT:N0000178480')
     OR (predicate = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/hasPhysiologicEffect'
         AND object = 'https://clinical-study-lab.example/ontology/DrugClass/MEDRT:N0000175372')
)
SELECT
  a.arm_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.participant) AS participants_started_prohibited_med
FROM csla_participants c
JOIN arm a          ON a.participant = c.participant
JOIN first_dose fd  ON fd.participant = c.participant
JOIN conmed_link cl ON cl.participant = c.participant
JOIN conmed_drug cd ON cd.conmed = cl.conmed
JOIN prohibited_drug pd ON pd.drug = cd.drug
JOIN conmed_start cs ON cs.conmed = cl.conmed
WHERE fd.first_dose_date IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.start_date >= fd.first_dose_date
  AND cs.start_date <= DATE'2026-10-31'
GROUP BY a.arm_code
ORDER BY a.arm_code

rows.context:
# CSL-A Prohibited Medication Starts: 60 Participants Through 2026-10-31

**60 CSL-A participants** started a protocol-prohibited medication on or after their first dose through 2026-10-31 — **20 in the CSL-101 arm** and **40 in the placebo arm**. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_f1c0cf)

<!-- begin-embedded:query_f1c0cf -->
| ARMCD | ARM | participants_with_prohibited_med |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | 20 |
| PBO | Placebo once weekly | 40 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_f1c0cf -->

All violations were **GLP-1 receptor agonists**; no appetite suppressants were started during the period. [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_826040)

## Breakdown by drug and arm

<!-- begin-embedded:query_826040 -->
| ARMCD | ARM | prohib_class | drug | participants |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | tirzepatide | 10 |
| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | semaglutide | 5 |
| CSL101 | CSL-101 10 mg once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | liraglutide | 5 |
| PBO | Placebo once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | semaglutide | 24 |
| PBO | Placebo once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | tirzepatide | 13 |
| PBO | Placebo once weekly | GLP-1 receptor agonist | liraglutide | 3 |
<!-- end-embedded:query_826040 -->

- **Placebo arm** had a notably higher rate: 40 of 1,271 dosed participants (3.1%) vs. 20 of 2,772 in the CSL-101 arm (0.7%). [Query Result](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/chat/threads/cafb1381f6ee460ab4512705225f6536?o=7474653847172668#embed-query_01fff2) Semaglutide was the most common prohibited start in the placebo arm (24 participants), followed by tirzepatide (13) and liraglutide (3).
- **CSL-101 arm** violations were led by tirzepatide (10), then semaglutide and liraglutide (5 each).

## Method

Prohibited medications are defined by the **PROHIB-CM-V1** concept class: any drug that is a member of the MED-RT class **GLP-1 Receptor Agonist [EPC]** (N0000178480), or any drug whose MED-RT physiologic effect is **Appetite Suppression [PE]** (N0000175372). [Prohibited medications (PROHIB-CM-V1)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/1ae156b3-ab07-446e-809f-086ff44d2980?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668) The protocol names classes, not products — class membership was resolved through the `kb_edge` knowledge graph. [Knowledge snippet](#snippet-370487a5-2a96-42ac-9b23-cabccd02869f)

A concomitant medication record (`silver_cm`) was flagged when its start date (`CMSTDTC`) fell on or after the participant's first dose date (`RFXSTDTC` from `silver_dm`) and on or before 2026-10-31. Per the glossary page, a prohibited medication started during treatment constitutes a major protocol deviation (intercurrent event): the participant stays in the FAS but leaves the PPS. [Prohibited medications (PROHIB-CM-V1)](https://fevm-eli-test-classic.cloud.databricks.com/one/discover/pages/1ae156b3-ab07-446e-809f-086ff44d2980?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=7474653847172668)

*Synthetic demo data — not for clinical use.*

SQL Genie One ran:
SELECT * FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.concept_class WHERE class_id LIKE '%PROHIB%' OR label LIKE '%prohib%' OR label LIKE '%appetite%' OR label LIKE '%GLP%'

SELECT * FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root WHERE class_id LIKE '%PROHIB%'

SELECT concept_id, label, source FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_concept WHERE label LIKE '%Appetite Suppress%' OR label LIKE '%appetite suppress%' LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_cm WHERE STUDYID = 'CSL-A' LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT predicate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge WHERE predicate LIKE '%PE%' OR predicate LIKE '%physiol%' OR predicate LIKE '%has_PE%' OR predicate LIKE '%effect%' LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT predicate, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge WHERE object = 'MEDRT:N0000175372' GROUP BY predicate

SELECT USUBJID, ARMCD, ARM, RFXSTDTC, RFSTDTC FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm WHERE STUDYID = 'CSL-A' AND ARMCD IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

SELECT e.subject, k.label 
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge e
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_concept k ON k.concept_id = e.subject
WHERE e.predicate = 'medrt:memberOf' AND e.object = 'MEDRT:N0000178480'
ORDER BY k.label

SELECT e.subject, k.label 
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge e
JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_concept k ON k.concept_id = e.subject
WHERE e.predicate = 'medrt:has_PE' AND e.object = 'MEDRT:N0000175372'
ORDER BY k.label

SELECT DISTINCT predicate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge WHERE subject LIKE 'RXNORM:%' AND object LIKE 'MEDRT:%' LIMIT 20

WITH prohibited_drugs AS (
  -- GLP-1 receptor agonist class members
  SELECT subject AS rxnorm_id, 'GLP-1 receptor agonist' AS prohib_class
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge
  WHERE predicate = 'medrt:memberOf'
    AND object = 'MEDRT:N0000178480'
  UNION
  -- Drugs with Appetite Suppression physiologic effect
  SELECT subject AS rxnorm_id, 'Appetite suppressant' AS prohib_class
  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge
  WHERE predicate = 'medrt:has_PE'
    AND object = 'MEDRT:N0000175372'
),
csl_a_dosed AS (

  FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.silver_dm
  WHERE STUDYID = 'CSL-A'
    AND ARMCD IN ('CSL101', 'PBO')
    AND RFXSTDTC IS NOT NULL
),
